title: 数値計算プログラミング
subtitle: Numerical analysis and programming
keywords: Python programming 2.Simultaneous equations 3.Nonlinear equations 4.Numerical differentiation and integration 5.Differential equation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire numerical computation skills. (2) Develop the ability to perform numerical analysis. (3) Learn algorithms for high-accuracy computation.
advice: This course teaches numerical computation methods using Python programming. Numerical computation requires an understanding of numerical algorithms as well as the ability to create and execute programs. Students will develop numerous programs through exercises and reports. Through this process, students will acquire the skills to implement and solve various engineering problems as computer programs. [Learning Topics] 1. Basic linear calculus 2. Numerical solving of simultaneous linear equations 3. Numerical calculation of eigenvalues and eigenvectors 4. Numerical solving of nonlinear equations 5. Interpolation and least squares methods 6. Numerical differentiation and integration 7. Numerical solving of ordinary differential equations This course emphasizes programming exercises, so students should prepare thoroughly before each class. After class, students are expected to refine the coding programs and apply them to various engineering problems.
books: Python数値計算プログラミング[講談社サイエンティフィク]
requiredKnowledge: [Required] Completion of "Programming fundamentals" and "Linear algebra". Students should also review python operations and vector/matrix operations. [Related] Calculus, differential equations, and basic mechanics

activityGoals.body: Be able to create source code, including I/O and simple mathematical calculations.
Be able to solve equations numerically.
Be able to solve linear algebraic equations numerically.
Be able to calculate volume and the center of gravity using numerical integration.
Be able to analyze an equation of simple oscillation numerically.
Be able to develop and use source code that addresses a problem in mechanical engineering.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Coding in consideration of calculation accuracy. 2. Calculate solutions to nonlinear equations. 3. Calculate solutions to n-array linear equations with high accuracy. 4. Calculate the center of gravity numerically. 5. Solve simple hermonic motion numerically with high accuracy. 6. Apply to mechanical problems such as a rigid motion.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Perform four arithmetic operations, including logical expressions. 2. Obtain solutions to quadratic equations numerically. 3. Obtain solutions to simultaneous equations numerically. 4. Calculate integrals numerically using trapezoidal formulas. 5. Solve first-order differential equations numerically. 6. Analyze the motion of free fall numerically.
